zones.name: Perioculomotor zone (anterior mesencephalic zone)
zones.construction: A vertical line 6 mm long on the front of the midbrain, 2 mm lateral to where the model's oculomotor nerve leaves it (an incision parallel and lateral to the nerve, medial to the corticospinal fibres of the crus).

zones.name: Lateral mesencephalic sulcus
zones.construction: The groove on the side of the midbrain between the crus (in front) and the tegmentum (behind): the posterior edge of the model's crus on its lateral surface, from below the medial geniculate body down to the pons.

zones.name: Supracollicular zone
zones.construction: A transverse line just above the upper edge of the model's superior colliculus, from the midline 5 mm to each side (the length is illustrative; the incision's depth is limited by the aqueduct).

zones.name: Infracollicular zone
zones.construction: A transverse line midway between the lower edge of the model's inferior colliculus and its trochlear nerve where that runs furthest back (leaving the back of the midbrain), from the midline 5 mm to each side (the length is illustrative).

zones.name: Supratrigeminal zone
zones.construction: A vertical line 4 mm long on the front of the pons, starting just below the pontomesencephalic sulcus (the top of the model's pons there), in the sagittal plane of the oculomotor nerve's exit.

zones.name: Peritrigeminal zone
zones.construction: A vertical line on the anterolateral pons, 3.5 mm medial to where the model's trigeminal nerve enters it, from that level halfway down towards the facial nerve's exit (between the nerve and the corticospinal fibres).

zones.name: Suprafacial triangle
zones.construction: On the floor of the fourth ventricle: a triangle with its base on the rostral margin of the facial colliculus, from 0.5 mm off the median sulcus (the medial longitudinal fasciculus) to the sulcus limitans, and its apex at the top of the floor. The facial colliculus is placed by the proportions measured in 40 cadavers (Erginoglu 2026): its rostral margin 43.6 % of the floor's length below the aqueduct, its caudal margin 43.3 % above the obex; the sulcus limitans 3.1 mm (right) and 3.0 mm (left) from the median sulcus (the same study).

zones.name: Infrafacial triangle
zones.construction: On the floor of the fourth ventricle: a triangle with its base on the caudal margin of the facial colliculus (median sulcus to sulcus limitans, placed as for the suprafacial triangle) and its apex next to the median sulcus at the top of the model's hypoglossal nucleus (the hypoglossal trigone).

zones.name: Median sulcus above the facial colliculus
zones.construction: On the floor of the fourth ventricle: a strip 0.8 mm to each side of the median sulcus, from the rostral margin of the facial colliculus to the top of the floor.

zones.name: Anterolateral (preolivary) sulcus
zones.construction: The groove in front of the olive along which the model's hypoglossal rootlets leave the medulla, drawn from the lowest rootlet down to the lower end of the model's medulla (where the first cervical rootlets begin).

zones.name: Olivary zone
zones.construction: The surface of the medulla over the model's olive, between the preolivary sulcus in front and the postolivary sulcus behind.

zones.name: Postolivary (retro-olivary) sulcus
zones.construction: The groove behind the model's olive: its posterior edge on the surface of the medulla, from its upper to its lower end.

zones.name: Posterior median sulcus (below the obex)
zones.construction: The midline groove on the back of the medulla, from just below the obex (the lower tip of the model's fourth ventricle) to the lower end of its medulla.

zones.name: Posterior intermediate sulcus
zones.construction: The groove between the gracile and cuneate fasciculi on the back of the medulla, midway between the model's gracile and cuneate tubercles, from below the obex to the lower end of its medulla.

zones.name: Posterolateral sulcus
zones.construction: The groove between the cuneate fasciculus and the spinal trigeminal tract, midway between the model's cuneate and trigeminal tubercles, from below the obex to the lower end of its medulla.
